text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: HIGH queue backlog on /inference/requests. queue_length=5,300, avg_proc_ms=710. Severity: P2. PagerDuty incident: PD-89421. Docs: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/autoscale-backlog

pagerduty-bot: PD-89421 fired -> assigned to oncall (Alex Nguyen). Paging... :rotating_light:

Alex Nguyen: acked. looking now. putting a 5m note for initial triage. anyone already seeing customer impact?

Samir Patel: seeing elevated latencies on hosted-api metrics (per-route). errors up ~0.9% on text-gen, tail latency spiking. queue backlog concentrated in region us-west-2.

Maria Gomez: logs show worker pods at 100% CPU, OOMs on a few older nodes. autoscaler trending but not keeping up; max_replicas=50, current=48, scaling cooldown set to 120s.

Alex Nguyen: ok — trying manual surge to buy time. running: ```kubectl scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=60 -n prod```. also bumping max_replicas to 80 in autoscaler config.

Samir Patel: on it. patching HPA now: ```kubectl patch hpa inference-worker -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":80}}' -n prod```

pagerduty-bot: PD-89421 acknowledged by Alex Nguyen at 2026-03-14T12:05:13Z

incident-bot: Autoscaler event: desired=60, current=48, nodes_request_pending=4. Provisioner report: 2 new GPU nodes booting, ETA ~3m.

Jordan Lee: I'll take CPU/ram node health and check for node-oom kernel logs. pinging infra to confirm capacity pool has available GPUs. @Taylor (oncall-manager) FYI for possible customer communications.

Samir Patel: after scale, queue length dropped to ~1,800, avg_proc_ms down to 430. still seeing some 503s for long-running requests. we should consider temporarily rerouting non-critical batch jobs to dedicated pool.

Maria Gomez: launching emergency route ACL: disable /metrics-sync and lower priority background tasks. applying rate limit for anonymous traffic to reduce pressure.

Alex Nguyen: applied temporary route limits. verifying error rate: errors down to 0.35%. tail latency improving but not back to baseline.

pagerduty-bot: PD-89421 escalation triggered (15m unacked/mitigated threshold) -> Taylor (oncall-manager) notified.

Taylor (oncall-manager): thanks team. good work on surge. please prepare a brief incident note for cumulative customer impact: affected endpoints, timeframe, percent requests impacted, and mitigation timeline. I'll coordinate comms if needed.

Jordan Lee: infra confirmed 2 additional GPU nodes added to cluster; autoscaler logs show backlog in scaling decisions due to cooldown setting (120s) + scale rate limit (2 pods/min). That's the primary reason it lagged.

Samir Patel: temp fix: relaxed scale rate to 10 pods/min and cooldown to 30s. applied in staging and then prod. command diff: ```- cooldown: 120s
+ cooldown: 30s
- rateLimit: 2
+ rateLimit: 10```

Maria Gomez: monitoring for flapping — added a 10m guard to prevent thrash. if we see oscillation we'll rollback to safer values and do a slower ramp.

Alex Nguyen: handoff to Jordan for next 30min while I get breakfast and file initial incident ticket. Jordan, key things: watch queue length, node health, and error rates. I put a pinned gist with commands: https://gist.github.com/redwood/oncall-pager-cmds

Jordan Lee: got it. I'm taking oncall. silencing notifications for PD-89421 for 20m while we stabilize.

pagerduty-bot: PD-89421: silenced for 20 minutes by Jordan Lee.

Maria Gomez: customer impact estimate so far: window 12:04 - 12:28 UTC, ~0.9% elevated error rate peak, ~4% of requests experienced >2x latency, impacted customers primarily small-medium hosted-API tenants in us-west-2.

Samir Patel: creating followup ticket to tune autoscaler thresholds and ensure capacity headroom: https://issues.redwood/OPS-5127. Proposed next steps: 1) raise default max_replicas for region us-west-2, 2) adjust cooldown/rate limits, 3) add pre-warm buffer when predictive traffic spike detected, 4) improve alerting to trigger predictive scale earlier.

Alex Nguyen: filing PD-89421 notes and marking incident state = mitigated. leaving Jordan onwatch for 30m then hand back to rotation.

Taylor (oncall-manager): thanks everyone. please add any postmortem items to OPS-5127 and link any runbook updates. We'll review in weekly SRE sync.

Jordan Lee: queue stabilized at ~200, avg_proc_ms 220, pod_count=62, cpu steady. closing loop. I'll update the incident ticket with final timestamps and handback note.

pagerduty-bot: PD-89421 status -> Mitigated by Alex Nguyen.

incident-bot: Note: create follow-up runbook PR for autoscaler tuning.

Alex Nguyen: final note: no customer-facing outage declared. recommend scheduled follow-up with product to verify SLAs and consider reserved capacity offers for big tenants in us-west-2.
